paraphrase: Ethics, study, reflection and meditation practised for this life's sake are without essence: ethics kept for this life is the root of the lower realms, study and reflection so done are the root of pride and dispute, meditation so done is only a basis for worldly distraction — so do not be attached to this life.
notes: Paraphrase of the song's argument for each line, recalled in outline only; not a verse-level record.

paraphrase: Reflecting on the sufferings of the three lower realms, of the gods and humans, and on the change and pervasive suffering of all saṃsāra, there is no happiness in it; so give up attachment to the three realms.
notes: Paraphrase of the song's argument for each line, recalled in outline only; not a verse-level record.

paraphrase: Liberating only oneself is useless when all beings of the three realms have been one's parents; generate the mind of awakening for them, taking on their suffering and giving them one's happiness.
notes: Paraphrase of the song's argument for each line, recalled in outline only; not a verse-level record.

paraphrase: There is no liberation for one who clings to existence, no higher rebirth for one who clings to non-existence, and clinging to both is ignorance; rest free of extremes in the natural state beyond elaboration.
notes: Paraphrase of the song's argument for each line, recalled in outline only; not a verse-level record.
